page_title: Anesthesia Marijuana Strain - Kind Green Buds

source_page_metadata.description: Explore the Anesthesia marijuana strain - THC levels, genetics, terpene profile, effects, flavor, and grow tips.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-Dominant Hybrid
Genetics: Northern Lights × Black Domina
Breeder: Pyramid Seeds
THC Content: 18–24%
CBD Content: Low (typically under 1%)
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , Caryophyllene , Linalool
Primary Flavors: Earthy, Sweet, Hashy, Spicy
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Late September
Indoor Yield: 16–20 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 18–22 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Easy to Moderate

Certain cannabis cultivars are designed with a clear purpose: to quiet the mind and slow the body. Anesthesia falls squarely into that category. Developed by Pyramid Seeds, the strain blends two powerful indica lineages—Northern Lights and Black Domina—to produce a marijuana variety that emphasizes physical relaxation and tranquility.

Rather than stimulating mental activity or conversation, the experience tends to guide the body toward stillness. Aromas reminiscent of traditional hashish combine with a thick, resinous bud structure typical of classic indica genetics. For cannabis enthusiasts seeking a deeply calming weed variety, this cultivar has developed a reputation for delivering a slow, grounding effect that settles both body and mood.
Genetics and Lineage

Anesthesia originates from the breeding work of Pyramid Seeds, a Spanish cannabis seed company known for producing stable indica-dominant hybrids. The strain combines Northern Lights and Black Domina, two legendary cannabis varieties recognized for their powerful relaxing qualities and strong resin production.

Northern Lights serves as the backbone of the genetic structure. This famous indica strain has influenced countless hybrids since its emergence in the 1980s. Known for dense flowers and calming effects, Northern Lights introduces the smooth body relaxation that characterizes the experience. It also contributes subtle sweetness and earthy aromas often associated with classic marijuana varieties.

Black Domina adds additional depth to the hybrid . This cultivar, itself a combination of several indica strains including Afghani genetics, is celebrated for its potent sedative qualities and compact growth structure. When paired with Northern Lights, the result is a plant that produces thick resin-coated buds and a high that gradually settles into profound physical calm.
Effects and Experience

The experience typically begins with a gentle shift in mood rather than a sudden surge of stimulation. After inhalation, many individuals notice a gradual easing of mental tension accompanied by a sense of quiet focus. Thoughts may slow slightly, creating a relaxed mental environment that feels comfortable and unhurried.

As the high develops, the physical effects become more noticeable. Muscles often begin to loosen, and a warm sensation of relaxation spreads throughout the body. Instead of creating an overwhelming heaviness immediately, the experience unfolds in stages, eventually guiding the body into a deeply tranquil state.

Later in the session, sedation can become more pronounced. The calming qualities of the strain make it particularly suitable for evening use, when the goal is to unwind rather than remain active. For many cannabis consumers, the plant offers a soothing conclusion to the day, encouraging rest and quiet reflection.
Medical Benefits

The deeply relaxing qualities of Anesthesia have drawn attention among patients seeking cannabis for therapeutic purposes. The cultivar’s ability to promote muscle relaxation may help individuals coping with physical tension or general bodily discomfort. For people experiencing lingering aches after long days of physical activity, the calming body effects can provide noticeable relief.

Sleep support represents another area where the strain is frequently explored. As the effects progress, the tranquil body sensation and mental quiet often make it easier to settle into a restful state. Individuals who struggle with restlessness in the evening may find that this type of cannabis helps prepare the body for sleep.

Some patients also turn to indica-dominant cultivars when managing stress or emotional strain. The slow, grounding nature of the high can encourage a sense of calm and stability. For those incorporating medical marijuana into nighttime routines, strains with similar profiles are often favored for their ability to reduce mental agitation while supporting relaxation.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The aroma of Anesthesia leans toward traditional indica characteristics. When a jar of cured buds is opened, earthy hash-like notes often dominate the first impression. Beneath that foundation, hints of pine and warm spice emerge, giving the fragrance a rich and slightly herbal quality.

Breaking apart the flowers reveals additional layers in the terpene profile . Myrcene contributes the earthy sweetness typical of many indica strains, while caryophyllene introduces a peppery spice that adds complexity. Limonene appears more subtly, providing a faint citrus brightness that prevents the aroma from becoming overly heavy.

The flavor closely follows the aromatic experience. Inhalation often brings forward earthy hash tones accompanied by herbal spice. On the exhale, a mild sweetness appears alongside subtle citrus and pine notes. The smoke typically feels thick yet smooth, leaving behind a lingering herbal aftertaste.
Growing Information

Anesthesia tends to exhibit growth patterns typical of indica-dominant cannabis plants. The plant generally develops a compact structure with short internodal spacing and strong lateral branches. Because of this natural shape, it adapts well to indoor environments where vertical space may be limited.

Flowering usually completes within eight to nine weeks. During this stage, dense buds begin to form along the branches, gradually becoming coated in a heavy layer of resin. As the harvest window approaches, the plant releases an increasingly rich aroma reminiscent of earthy hash and spice.

For cultivators planning to grow weed , this strain is considered relatively manageable compared with many sativa-heavy varieties. The plant responds well to consistent lighting, moderate feeding schedules, and good airflow. With proper care, growers can expect compact plants that produce thick, aromatic flowers with strong visual appeal.
FAQ
What strain is Anesthesia? Anesthesia is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by Pyramid Seeds using Northern Lights and Black Domina genetics.
How strong is Anesthesia? THC levels generally range between 18% and 23%. The potency combined with its indica genetics often produces a deeply relaxing effect.
What does Anesthesia taste like? The flavor profile typically includes earthy hash notes, herbal spice, and subtle sweetness with hints of pine and citrus.
Is Anesthesia good for sleep? Many cannabis consumers choose the strain for evening use because its calming body effects can support relaxation and help prepare the body for rest.

How long does the Anesthesia high last? The effects often last two to three hours depending on dosage and tolerance, beginning with gentle mental calm before transitioning into deeper physical relaxation.
Final Thoughts on Anesthesia

Among indica-dominant cannabis strains, Anesthesia stands out for its clear emphasis on physical relaxation and tranquil mental effects. By combining Northern Lights and Black Domina genetics, breeders created a cultivar capable of delivering a slow, soothing experience that contrasts sharply with stimulating sativa varieties .

Another notable aspect of the strain lies in its classic aroma and flavor. Earthy hash tones, peppery spice, and faint citrus create a terpene profile reminiscent of traditional marijuana cultivars. For enthusiasts who appreciate old-school indica characteristics , the plant offers a familiar and comforting sensory experience.

Growers also value the cultivar for its manageable growth patterns and resin-rich flowers. The compact structure and reliable flowering period make it accessible to cultivators seeking productive plants without excessive complexity. Taken together, these characteristics explain why Anesthesia remains a respected choice among cannabis varieties designed for relaxation. Its calming effects, traditional flavor profile, and stable genetics ensure that it continues to occupy a place within the broader landscape of modern marijuana strains .
